name: 87. Anthropic ingress non-streaming truncation reports stop_reason max_tokens (#6782)
description:
Pins that a non-streaming turn cut short by the output-token cap reports stop_reason max_tokens on /anthropic/v1/messages, not end_turn.

Bug (#6782): OpenAI-shaped Responses providers (Azure /openai/v1/responses, OpenAI, and every chat-completions provider whose finish_reason "length" becomes status incomplete via responsesStatusFromChatFinishReason in core/schemas/mux.go) never send stop_reason; the truncation lives only in incomplete_details.reason. ToAnthropicResponsesResponse in core/providers/anthropic/responses.go read only StopReason and defaulted to end_turn, so a 4096-token truncated reply on Azure Fireworks Foundry models was reported as a clean finish. Folder 65 pins the streaming twin (#6081, fixed in #6805); this folder pins the non-streaming encoder.

The Azure half of #6782 (Fireworks Foundry deployments routed to /openai/v1/chat/completions when their datasheet row lists no /v1/responses endpoint) cannot be pinned here: the harness Azure account has no Fireworks deployment and the gate depends on datasheet rows shipped separately. It is covered by TestAzureResponsesHonoursDatasheetSupportedEndpoints in core/providers/azure/azure_test.go.

item.name: openai/gpt-4o-mini /anthropic/v1/messages non-streaming truncated by max_tokens reports stop_reason max_tokens - #6782

exec: pm.test('openai chat via anthropic ingress: non-streaming truncation reports stop_reason max_tokens, not end_turn - #6782', function () {
var j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {
pm.expect.fail('response was not JSON: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)); return; }
pm.expect(j.usage && j.usage.output_tokens, 'usage.output_tokens must be reported: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(j.stop_reason, 'a turn cut by max_tokens=16 must not be reported as a clean finish: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.equal('max_tokens');

body.raw: {"model":"openai/gpt-4o-mini","max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Count from 1 to 1000, one number per line."}]}
